name: Na Hye-seok
shortBio: Korean feminist philosopher, writer, and painter who challenged Neo-Confucian chastity norms and colonial patriarchy, arguing that women are autonomous human beings prior to maternal or marital roles.
centralQuestion: How can women claim moral personhood and creative self-authorship against Neo-Confucian chastity ideology and colonial gender double standards?

keyWorks.title: Gyeonghui
keyWorks.description: Philosophical narrative interrogating women’s existential vocation and rejection of domestic servitude in colonial Korea.

keyWorks.title: A Confession About My Divorce (Ihon Gobaekjang)
keyWorks.description: Radical critique of patriarchal chastity norms, demanding equal ethical standards for men and women in marriage and desire.
